title: Resources, Maintenance & Administrative Burden
objective: Deliver one bounded read-only projection for explicit visible resource position, maintenance state and administrative burden observations over existing canonical owner references without manufacturing balances, automatic depletion/failure, spending authority, maintenance execution, Project/time mutation or a duplicate ledger.

resolved_contract.owner_rule: Every accepted observation is explicit owner evidence with subject, kind, qualitative state when observed, owner authority/reference, profile/context, provenance and visibility references. MIB-13 remains Economy/trade authority and forbids a second balance or asset ledger; MIB-14 remains Base/Vehicle owner truth; APW-D26 remains Project authority; DPL/WCI and Permission/visibility remain unchanged.
resolved_contract.resolution_rule: Visibility filtering occurs first. A projection kind resolves only when compatible visible observed evidence agrees on one qualitative band under one profile/context tuple. Missing or explicit-unknown remains unknown; incompatible-only remains incompatible; divergent visible band/profile/context tuples or mixed observed/incompatible evidence remains conflict. Canonical-owner contradictions are never auto-resolved.
resolved_contract.pressure_rule: ODL-02 administrative/load pressure is separately labeled advisory context only and never consumes resources, creates maintenance failure, changes a resource/maintenance/admin state, imposes an action restriction or adjudicates an administrative outcome.
resolved_contract.role_rule: ODL-04 role/delegation/authority-scope evidence is separately labeled advisory context only and never grants spending, maintenance, Project/time, command or system-permission authority.
resolved_contract.time_rule: Maintenance due/deferred and resource/admin observations are owner-provided evidence only; wall-clock time and projected elapsed time never advance state or campaign time.
resolved_contract.visibility_rule: Unauthorized resource, maintenance, administrative, organization, role/delegation, Project, profile/context, provenance and permission evidence is filtered before states, counts, summaries, search, provenance, receipts or AI context; hidden cardinality remains undisclosed.
resolved_contract.mutation_rule: No balance/asset/cost/spending mutation, maintenance action, administrative outcome, owner mutation, Project/time advancement, relationship/faction mutation, command authority, system permission or canonical write is performed.
resolved_contract.persistence: No durable ODL-05 persistence or duplicate resource/maintenance/administration/Project/permission ledger; migration 0022 remains unreserved.
resolved_contract.validation: Acceptance first; genuine self-hosted RED while production pair is absent; exactly one ODL-05 current-family profile with zero historical predecessor fanout; final exact-head self-hosted Linux/Windows plus deterministic comparison.

preserved_boundaries: ODL-01..04 remain completed_verified and are not reopened.
Canonical Organization/Faction, MIB-13 Economy/trade, MIB-14 Base/Vehicle, APW-D26 Project/time/context, DPL, WCI and Permission/visibility owners remain authoritative.

No resource balance or asset mutation, spending/cost execution, maintenance action, administrative outcome, owner mutation, Project/time advancement, command/permission authority, duplicate ledger, durable persistence or migration 0022 is authorized.
ODL-06+, SCL-01+, provider activation, tester distribution, release and deployment remain unauthorized.
